title: Wong Ming Jeu

page_data.en:
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No....................
Date..................

February 17th 1926

Sir,
It is reported that the school mates of Captain Wong
Ling Jeu 黄鸣球 late Commander of the cruiser Chaoho,
have petitioned the Central Government to allow him to
proceed to Yunnan and retrieve his character by fighting
the rebels. It is said that the Government is not adverse
to this course.
The lantern festival will be celebrated to-day and
strict precautions are being taken in Chinese territory, for
it was rumoured that the rebels would rise on this date.
It is reported that Taoyin Chou will resign soon.
It appears he is dissatisfied because the Central Government
has given Yang Tcheng, Commissioner for Foreign Affairs,
charge of the land office and because it is said that the
Central Government will give him also the official control
of the Whangpoo Conservancy.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科）

刑事侦缉处
情报登记
编号....................
日期..................

1926年2月17日

先生：

据报，前“超武”号巡洋舰舰长黄鸣球（Wong Ling Jeu）的同窗校友已 petition 中央政府，准许他前往云南，通过讨伐叛军来挽回名誉。据悉，政府对此并不反对。

今日正值元宵节，在华界地区正采取严密防范措施，因为有谣言称叛军将在这一日起事。

据报，道尹周（Taoyin Chou）即将辞职。看来他因中央政府任命外交专员杨增（Yang Tcheng）掌管土地局而感到不满；此外，据称中央政府还将把吴淞江河道管理局的官方控制权也交予杨增。

您的恭顺仆人，

总探长

警务处总监
